newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN UP FOR THIRD SESSION RUNNING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN UP FOR THIRD SESSION RUNNING.

text.p: Polish shares on Tuesday were expected to rise for the third session, seen buoyed by good March earnings reports released late last week.

The 7.5 million shares in paper firm Celuloza Swiecie SA offered by the treasury last week at a minimum price of 15 zlotys will be allotted at a special bourse session on Tuesday. Analysts say the strike price could reach 20 zlotys.
